typecheck.// dependsOn: ^generate: this project compiles @bge/i18n-core through otel → actor-context, and its key types are generated and untracked, so a cold typecheck fails without them. ^typecheck: tsc --build rebuilds every referenced project, so without it this task races its dependencies' own typecheck over the same declarations (#330). The union, because a project-level dependsOn replaces the nx.json default rather than merging (#312).
typecheck.// inputs: The inferred list plus the generated TypeScript itself (the last entry, which hashes generate's output). The client and migrations manifest are gitignored, so without it a schema or migration change keeps this task's hash and restores stale declarations. See docs/NX_CACHING.md.

test.// inputs: The inferred list plus the generated TypeScript itself (the dependentTasksOutputFiles entry, which hashes generate's output), plus a hash of the path and content of every TypeScript source file under libs/ and apps/ that mentions a permission (the runtime entry). The specs read what generate writes into the gitignored generated directory, the client and unit-id-columns.ts (#994), so without it a schema-only change keeps this task's hash and replays a cached pass. revoked-grant-loaders.spec.ts scans the source of every project for a reader of role grants that keeps revoked ones (#772); those projects depend on this one, not the reverse, so without the runtime entry a new reader is a cache hit here and is never scanned. Every line the scan can flag names a permission (permissions:, rolePermission, role_permissions), so a file that never mentions one cannot change its result, and a change to it leaves this task cached. A runtime input, not file globs: a {workspaceRoot} glob would also make this project affected by every .ts change, and with it everything that depends on it. See docs/NX_CACHING.md.

inputs.runtime: git grep -l -i -F --untracked permission -- 'libs/*.ts' 'apps/*.ts' ':!*.spec.ts' ':!*.d.ts' | (paths=$(cat); printf '%s\n' "$paths"; printf '%s\n' "$paths" | git hash-object --stdin-paths) | git hash-object --stdin
